source: The server runtime ({0}) does not know which builder produced the app. It imports each build artifact through a stable {1} subpath, and the active builder populates those subpaths with {2}. This is the **build output contract**.
text: Le runtime serveur ({0}) ne sait pas quel builder a produit l'application. Il importe chaque artefact de build via un sous-chemin {1} stable, et le builder actif alimente ces sous-chemins avec {2}. C'est le **contrat de sortie du build**.
